text: Teaching Objectives This program is designed to help students learn how business operations and decisions are shaped by a global market environment. It focuses on the use of analytical tools to help business leaders make better and more informed decisions by enhancing their understanding and analysis of the risks, challenges and opportunities faced by businesses in the international arena. The focus on the Chinese business environment, Chinese language and work internship opportunities in China are additional features of this comprehensive program. Core Courses Elementary Chinese Econometrics and Quantitative Methods Research Methods Microeconomic Theory Macroeconomic Theory Operation Research International Business International Marketing Mergers and Acquisitions Cross Culture Communicationand Management Duration 2 years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Master Degree of International Business by Beijing Foreign Studies University
